supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: distinct extension visible beyond the outer corners of the eyes

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: low contrast; uniform dark pigmentation across the muzzle and periocular regions

other_distinctive_markers: bright, high-contrast white spot on the mid-frontal bone region
